lessons: Veto Double Chance '12' (lay-the-draw) bets whenever the market family or Matchbook record is LOSING; lowering confidence alone produced 7 losses.
Back 'Team or Draw' (1X/X2) over '12' Double Chance: 'Team or Draw' won 5 of 5, whereas '12' lost 11 of 32 times due to draws.
Do not veto Asian Handicap +1.5 or +2.5 selections on small model-to-breakeven deficits (<3%): positive handicap cushions won 8 of 9 matches.
Veto 'Win to Nil — no' at odds <=1.24: favorites kept clean sheets in 3 of 4 graded verdicts.
Veto Under 3.5 totals in lower league/cup fixtures (0 of 2 hit); reserve Under backing for high cushions (Under 4.5 and Under 5.5, which hit 6 of 8).
Strictly veto Over 1.5 goals at short odds (1.20–1.24) when the framework record is LOSING; it failed in 3 of 8 instances.
Veto Double Chance '12' matches when missing player value exceeds 20% for either side; roster depletion resulted in draws in 4 of 6 cases.
Avoid Double Chance '12' at odds above 1.30: higher-priced DC lines lost 3 of 6 times (Getafe, Celta B, Stuttgart).
football.summary: Established initial rule set penalizing vulnerable '12' Double Chance and Win-to-Nil bets while loosening vetoes on resilient +1.5/+2.5 Asian handicaps.

lessons: When backing 1st half NBA totals with model probabilities above 0.60, require odds of 1.90 or higher to maintain positive expected value.
nba.summary: Added a concrete rule on minimum odds thresholds for high-probability 1st half NBA total bets based on recent results.
